scope: Hypothetical mechanics study using a historical LRT-2 mass convention. Not an actual route or calibrated fleet prediction.
units: SI: m, s, kg, N, W, J

mass_kg.basis: 160100 + 826 * 65; occupancy and per-person mass are scenario conventions

rotating_mass_kg.basis: 0.10 times historical tare mass; not measured inertia

traction_force_n.basis: Finite wheel-force stress setting; not inferred from the AW3 acceleration rating

wheel_power_w.basis: Mechanical wheel power stress setting; not aggregated motor ratings

service_brake_force_n.basis: Constant whole-train wheel-brake force; no emergency rating substitution or load-compensation law

davis_c_ns2_per_m2.basis: Whole-train coefficient in N s^2/m^2; includes aerodynamic resistance

route.basis: Synthetic 1000 m along-track profile and spatial speed limits; not a named interstation section

control.basis: Forward departure from rest; coast request from 500 m subordinate to braking limits; timeout is a feasibility bound

settings.basis: DOP853 tolerances and maximum time/distance steps; tested by refinement
